mapper.select: SELECT C.CHTRM_ID, CASE WHEN C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN ( SELECT E.EMP_NM FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT OP JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = OP.EMP_ID WHERE OP.CHTRM_ID = C.CHTRM_ID AND OP.EMP_ID <> #{empId} AND OP.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1 ) ELSE C.CHTRM_NM END AS CHTRM_NM, C.CHTRM_EXPLN, C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD, C.ESTBLSH_ID, C.CREAT_DT, C.END_DT, LM.LAST_MESSAGE, LM.LAST_TIME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT CP WHERE CP.CHTRM_ID = C.CHTRM_ID AND CP.LEAV_DT IS NULL ) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT, CASE WHEN C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN ( SELECT OP.PTCPT_STTUS_CD FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT OP WHERE OP.CHTRM_ID = C.CHTRM_ID AND OP.EMP_ID <> #{empId} AND OP.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1 ) END AS STATUS, CASE WHEN C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN ( SELECT JP.JOB_PSTN_NM FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT OP JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = OP.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_POSITION JP ON JP.JOB_PSTN_CD = E.JOB_PSTN_CD WHERE OP.CHTRM_ID = C.CHTRM_ID AND OP.EMP_ID <> #{empId} AND OP.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1 ) END AS JOB_TITLE, CASE WHEN C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN ( SELECT D.DEPT_NM FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT OP JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = OP.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD WHERE OP.CHTRM_ID = C.CHTRM_ID AND OP.EMP_ID <> #{empId} AND OP.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1 ) END AS DEPARTMENT, CASE WHEN C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN ( SELECT E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT OP JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = OP.EMP_ID WHERE OP.CHTRM_ID = C.CHTRM_ID AND OP.EMP_ID <> #{empId} AND OP.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1 ) END AS PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MSNGR_MSG UM WHERE UM.CHTRM_ID = C.CHTRM_ID AND UM.CREAT_DT >= P.JOIN_DT AND ( P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID IS NULL OR UM.MSG_ID > P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID ) ) AS UNREAD_COUNT, P.CHTRM_ID AS PTCPT_CHTRM_ID, P.EMP_ID, P.PTCPT_STTUS_CD, P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID, P.JOIN_DT, P.LEAV_DT FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM C JOIN TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT P ON C.CHTRM_ID = P.CHTRM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CHTRM_ID, MSG_CN AS LAST_MESSAGE, TO_CHAR(CREAT_DT, 'HH24:MI') AS LAST_TIME, CREAT_DT AS LAST_MSG_DT FROM ( SELECT M.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY M.CHTRM_ID ORDER BY M.CREAT_DT DESC, M.MSG_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM TB_MSNGR_MSG M ) WHERE RN = 1 ) LM ON C.CHTRM_ID = LM.CHTRM_ID WHERE P.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND P.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND C.END_DT IS NULL ORDER BY NVL(LM.LAST_MSG_DT, C.CREAT_DT) DESC

SELECT C.CHTRM_ID, C.CHTRM_NM, C.CHTRM_EXPLN, C.CHTRM_TYPE_CD, C.ESTBLSH_ID, C.CREAT_DT, C.END_DT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT CP WHERE CP.CHTRM_ID = C.CHTRM_ID AND CP.LEAV_DT IS NULL ) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT, P.CHTRM_ID AS PTCPT_CHTRM_ID, P.EMP_ID, P.PTCPT_STTUS_CD, P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID, P.JOIN_DT, P.LEAV_DT FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM C LEFT JOIN TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT P ON C.CHTRM_ID = P.CHTRM_ID WHERE C.CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} AND P.LEAV_DT IS NULL
SELECT CHTRM_ID, EMP_ID, PTCPT_STTUS_CD, LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID, JOIN_DT, LEAV_DT FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT WHERE CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} AND EMP_ID = #{empId}

SELECT M.MSG_ID, M.CHTRM_ID, M.SNDR_ID, M.MSG_CN, M.CREAT_DT, E.EMP_NM AS SENDER_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT P WHERE P.CHTRM_ID = M.CHTRM_ID AND (P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID IS NULL OR P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID < M.MSG_ID ) AND P.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND P.JOIN_DT <= M.CREAT_DT ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TB_MSNGR_MSG M JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON M.SNDR_ID = E.EMP_ID WHERE M.MSG_ID = #{msgId}

SELECT M.MSG_ID, M.CHTRM_ID, M.SNDR_ID, M.MSG_CN, M.CREAT_DT, E.EMP_NM AS SENDER_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT P WHERE P.CHTRM_ID = M.CHTRM_ID AND (P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID IS NULL OR P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID < M.MSG_ID ) AND P.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND P.JOIN_DT <= M.CREAT_DT ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TB_MSNGR_MSG M JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON M.SNDR_ID = E.EMP_ID WHERE M.CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} ORDER BY M.CREAT_DT ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHTRM_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_MSNGR_CHTRM ( CHTRM_ID, CHTRM_NM, CHTRM_EXPLN, CHTRM_TYPE_CD, ESTBLSH_ID, CREAT_DT ) VALUES ( #{chtrmId}, #{chtrmNm}, #{chtrmExpln}, #{chtrmTypeCd}, #{estblshId}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT ( CHTRM_ID, EMP_ID, PTCPT_STTUS_CD, JOIN_DT ) VALUES ( #{chtrmId}, #{empId}, #{ptcptSttusCd}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_MSG_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_MSNGR_MSG ( MSG_ID, CHTRM_ID, SNDR_ID, MSG_CN, CREAT_DT ) VALUES ( #{msgId}, #{chtrmId}, #{sndrId}, #{msgCn}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MSNGR_CHTRM SET END_DT = SYSDATE WHERE CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} AND END_DT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT SET PTCPT_STTUS_CD = #{ptcptSttusCd}, LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID = NULL, JOIN_DT = SYSDATE, LEAV_DT = NULL WHERE CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} AND EMP_ID = #{empId} AND LEAV_DT IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT PTCPT_STTUS_CD FROM TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND LEAV_DT IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MSNGR_MSG M JOIN TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT P ON P.CHTRM_ID = M.CHTRM_ID WHERE M.CHTRM_ID = #{chtrmId} AND M.MSG_ID = #{msgId} AND P.LEAV_DT IS NULL AND P.JOIN_DT <= M.CREAT_DT AND ( P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID IS NULL OR P.LAST_CFMTN_MSG_ID < M.MSG_ID )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_MSNGR_CHTRM_PTCPT T USING ( SELECT #{chtrmId} AS CHTRM_ID, #{empId} AS EMP_ID, #{ptcptSttusCd} AS PTCPT_STTUS_CD FROM DUAL ) S ON ( T.CHTRM_ID = S.CHTRM_ID AND T.EMP_ID = S.EMP_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.PTCPT_STTUS_CD = S.PTCPT_STTUS_CD, T.LEAV_DT = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CHTRM_ID, EMP_ID, PTCPT_STTUS_CD ) VALUES ( S.CHTRM_ID, S.EMP_ID, S.PTCPT_STTUS_CD )
